GameUI_UpgradesPanel_Generic_Tooltip_Des: This building can be upgraded. Upgrade choices are final, and resources won't be refunded when the building is destroyed.
GameUI_UpgradesPanel_Levels_Tooltip_Desc: Mines can be upgraded to reach deeper mining veins. Only one upgrade can be bought per ground level. Some upgrades will lose their extra vein charges if they aren't selected (like the Box Crib upgrade), and building a new mine won't change that.
GameUI_UpgradesPanel_Requirements_Toolti: Every upgrade costs goods. Some resources can be changed by selecting the resource slot.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipBaseResolv: Base Resolve is the baseline amount of Resolve a species has, without any needs fulfilled or effects applied.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipBreakTime_: Every villager has to rest from time to time. The break interval attribute shows the amount of time between breaks.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipDecadent_D: Shows how much the reputation threshold increases after generating a reputation point. Highly decadent species require more Resolve to generate subsequent reputation points.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipDemanding_: Shows how much Resolve is required to start gaining Reputation. More demanding species have a higher initial threshold.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipHungerStac: The maximum amount of hunger stacks a species can withstand.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipResilient_: Shows how fast Resolve reacts to change. A highly resilient species reacts very slowly to Resolve effects.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Races_TooltipStats_Desc: Every species has different attributes. Hover over the name of an attribute to learn what it means.
GameUI_WikiPopup_RelicLocked_TooltipDesc: Complete this event at least once to unlock its entry in the encyclopedia.
GameUI_WikiPopup_Unknown_Tooltip: Complete this event at least once to unlock it in the in-game encyclopedia.
GameUI_WildcardPickPopup_Tooltip_Desc: Wildcards are very rare rewards that allow you to select one or more blueprints from the entire pool of buildings you have unlocked.
GameUI_WildcardPopup_Dialogue: A mysterious smuggler has appeared in your settlement. In his cart, hidden beneath barrels of whiskey, you can see a suspiciously rich selection of blueprints.
GameUI_WorkerSlot_AutomatonTooltip_Desc: It doesn't eat and doesn't need rest. Its sole purpose is to work. Automatons have no chance of producing double yields.
GameUI_WorkshopIngredientsStorage_Toolti: Workers will fetch goods from the internal storage of nearby buildings, or a Warehouse (depending on whichever is closer).

HighestSealSaveUpgradePopup_Desc:
Since your last session, we've added a new world map feature - Ancient Seals. Their premise is to guide players through gradually increasing levels of difficulty.

As you’ve already won games on Prestige, you can choose to skip lower seals and jump right to your current difficulty level. You can also just start from the initial difficulty if you want. Either way, your Citadel’s progress will remain intact.

Intro_1: The world is plagued by the Blightstorm - a vile cycle of destruction ravaging everything in its path. The only safe haven is the Smoldering City, where the mysterious Scorched Queen reigns.
Intro_2: You are one of her viceroys - a pioneer sent into the wilds, tasked with establishing new settlements and acquiring valuable resources for the crown.
Intro_3: Your goal is to help rebuild the Smoldering City, and secure the future of the Queen’s subjects.
